AES+Copy random-access interoperability fixture

Generated independently with py7zr 1.1.3 using
filters=[{'id': FILTER_COPY}, {'id': FILTER_CRYPTO_AES256_SHA256}]
and password 'synthetic-密码-🙂'. The only member is payload.bin:

    bytes(range(256)) * 513 + b'random-tail\x01'

Its 131340 plaintext bytes require four alignment-padding bytes. The final
real byte is 0x01; it must not be mistaken for PKCS#7 padding. The non-ASCII
password exercises the existing 7z UTF-16LE key derivation. Salt and IV were
generated by the independent writer. All names and contents are synthetic.
